description: Proptest proptest_together_sub_step_output_produces_different_digest (together_digest_sensitivity.rs:212-240) is completely unmapped in the obligation bridge matrix. The proof evidence shows 6 proptest tests passing, but only 5 are mapped to obligations. The unmapped test verifies that different sub-step output names produce different digests — a sensitivity property not covered by any other mapped test. Zero traceability to any PO or contract clause.
remediation: Either (a) add a new proof obligation row mapping this test to contract clause C-04, (b) delete the test from the proptest file if genuinely redundant, or (c) document explicit justification for leaving it unmapped with compensating evidence from another mapped test.

description: Kani harness canonical_name_aggregate_harness (kani_canonical_name.rs:84-106) is completely unmapped in the bridge. The harness asserts canonical_primitive_name(Aggregate) == 'reduce', but production code at part_05.rs:107 returns 'aggregate' — the harness WILL FAIL if executed. The bridge's Kani Harness Files table lists only 2 of 3 harnesses, omitting this one. TB-xi2f29-025 says 'canonical_name_aggregate_harness pending' but the bridge has zero references to it.
remediation: Either (a) map the harness with exact source refs, evidence command, and status (likely FAILING given production code mismatch), (b) remove the harness from the Kani file entirely, or (c) document why this harness is intentionally unmapped and note the production-code assertion mismatch risk.

description: PO-001 and PO-015 share identical behavior test (test_canonical_primitive_name_together_returns_together) and identical refinement harness (canonical_name_together_harness) yet have conflicting statuses: PO-001 is 'materialized', PO-015 is 'materialized (weak)'. The unit test does NOT directly assert canonical_primitive_name(Together) == 'together' — it verifies digest non-zero and determinism, properties already covered by PO-006 and PO-013. The 'weak' finding applies equally to PO-001's behavior test evidence.
remediation: Either (a) redirect PO-015's behavior test to a direct canonical_primitive_name assertion, (b) merge PO-015 into PO-001 since both verify the same claim with the same Kani harness, or (c) reclassify PO-015 as 'merged/redundant' and remove its behavior test mapping from the bridge.
